title: CASD: Chunk-Aligned Semantic Distillation for Multi-StageRobot Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2609.08638v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An action chunk can span several stages of a manipulation task, yet a label for its first step describes only the current stage. We introduce Chunk-Aligned Semantic Distillation (CASD), which derives semantic targets for entire action chunks. An offline vision--language model segments demonstrations into described stages. Their occupancy within each action chunk determines a weighted semantic target, including transitions between stages. A CASD generator learns to predict this target from the current observation, robot state, and task instruction. We then freeze the generator and train a policy conditioned on its predictions. The semantic branch runs once per policy query, without online VLM calls or reasoning-trace decoding. Teacher matching on annotated LIBERO training episodes is above chance for both single-stage and boundary-crossing chunks. translated_title: CASD：面向多阶段机器人操作的块对齐语义蒸馏
translated_abstract: 一个动作块可以跨越操作任务的多个阶段，然而其第一步的标签仅描述当前阶段。我们提出了块对齐语义蒸馏（CASD），为整个动作块推导语义目标。一个离线视觉-语言模型将演示分割为带有描述的阶段，这些阶段在每个动作块中的占比决定了一个加权的语义目标，其中包括阶段之间的过渡。一个CASD生成器学习从当前观测、机器人状态和任务指令中预测该目标。随后我们冻结该生成器，并以它的预测作为条件训练一个策略。语义分支在每次策略查询时仅需运行一次，无需在线VLM调用或推理轨迹解码。在标注的LIBERO训练片段上的教师匹配结果表明，无论是单阶段块还是跨越阶段边界的块，其准确率均高于随机水平。我们在四个基准上评估了三种Fast-WAM变体和一个DreamZero集成……
tldr: CASD通过离线视觉-语言模型将演示分割为语义阶段，为整个动作块推导加权语义目标并训练轻量生成器进行预测，在无需在线VLM调用的情况下显著提升多阶段机器人操作策略的学习效果。
en_tdlr: CASD derives weighted semantic targets for entire action chunks by segmenting demonstrations into stages with an offline vision-language model and training a lightweight generator to predict them, improving multi-stage robot manipulation policies without online VLM calls.
